(b) For a semi-formal evening, you could wear a tailored midi dress in a flattering cut, paired with comfortable block heels. Add a simple statement necklace and a small clutch for a polished finish. It’s an easy balance of style and comfort for any occasion.
(c) Since you’re a big Cubs fan from Chicago, you could wear a classy royal blue midi dress with a tailored blazer, paired with kitten heels for all-night comfort. Add subtle baseball-themed jewelry as a wink to your team spirit. It’s elegant but still nods to your hometown pride.
(d) Since you like going for monochrome looks sometimes, you could rock a sleek black jumpsuit with tailored lines, paired with low block heels for comfort.
